system.description:
You gain [Barrier: 30]. You also enter the [Flight] state and gain the [Radiance] and [Fairy] tags. This effect lasts until the end of the scene. (CR14) This item has no effect. A magical potion made from peaches that have been ripened under the sun for a century, completely dissolved into a liquid. The potion has a faint, hazy appearance like spring mist, and a subtle scent of peach rises from it. However, its effects are intense; upon consumption, an aura of light radiates from the entire body, and for a short time, the user is elevated to a magical existence.

Soft Stone [Core Material] (80G) + White Hitokata (Basic) (40G) ×2 + Elemental Card (Basic) (40G) + [Magic Catalyst 5] (40G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (110G)
